steps.text:
# Q3 Customer Feedback Brief

**Coverage caveat:** This covers **July and August only (12 comments)**. The September file (`q3_september.csv`) has ratings but no comment text, so it adds nothing to the themes or counts. The counts are small, so treat them as directional.

## Top themes

| # | Theme | Comments | Sentiment | Example quote |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Slow performance**: dashboards and reports load slowly | 4 of 12 | Negative (ratings 2) | "Load times are hurting my team's productivity" |
| 2 | **Helpful support** | 3 of 12 | Positive (ratings 4–5) | "Your support team is the best part of the product" |
| 3 (tie) | **App crashes** | 2 of 12 | Negative (ratings 1–2) | "The app crashed twice during a client demo" |
| 3 (tie) | **Billing confusion**: double charge, unclear plan tiers | 2 of 12 | Neutral to negative (ratings 3) | "Billing page doesn't explain the new plan tiers" |

The third place is a tie, so I've listed both themes. One more comment praised the new export button.

## Takeaways
- Slow loading is the biggest complaint. It showed up in both months and hasn't improved. One August comment began "Still slow."
- Support is the main strength.
- Crashes and billing clarity are smaller issues, but each is tied to a specific failure, such as a double charge or a lost client demo.

## Next step
Get the September comments if they exist. They could change the ranking, especially for the tied third place.
